title: Change NAME-buffer-list from defvar to defcustom
description: `NAME-buffer-list` is a plain `defvar`, not a `defcustom`. This means it resets to nil on package reload, losing track of live buffers. Consider making it persistent or at least documenting this behavior.

title: Add keybinding generation to vtermux-define
description: Currently `vtermux-define` only creates commands, leaving bindings to the user. Consider adding an optional `:bind` keyword or a separate `vtermux-bind` macro to auto-generate keybindings (e.g., with `:map` and `:keys` arguments).

title: Integrate vtermux--registry into commands or remove it
description: `vtermux--registry` is populated with (NAME . PROGRAM) pairs on each `vtermux-define` invocation, but no command ever consults it. Either remove the dead code or integrate it — e.g., a `vtermux-switch` dispatcher that shows all registered applications, or a `vtermux-list-apps` command.

title: Support :args as a list for proper argument handling
description: Currently `:args` is a single string concatenated with the program via `(format "%s %s" prog args)` for `vterm-shell`. This breaks for arguments with spaces or dynamic values. Support `:args` as a list of strings, joined properly before setting `vterm-shell`.

title: Add test framework and tests for vtermux.el
description: No tests exist. Testing would require mocking `vterm-mode` and process sentinels. Set up ERT tests with mocks for vterm and process functionality to cover all helper functions and macro generation.

title: Add vtermux-switch command to browse all vtermux buffers
description: Create a new command (not per-definition) that lists all vtermux buffers across all defined applications, with optional directory scoping via C-u. User can select a buffer to switch to. This complements the per-app NAME-select by providing a unified view.
